import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_cps_poverty_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='pov21', header=None)
# Find columns for 2010-2012 and 2023-2025 in row index 3
col_2023_2025 = [c for c in df.columns if '2023-2025' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]
col_2010_2012 = [c for c in df.columns if '2010-2012' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]

us_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'United States']
rate_2023_2025 = float(us_row[col_2023_2025].values[0])
rate_2010_2012 = float(us_row[col_2010_2012].values[0])
result = round(rate_2010_2012 - rate_2023_2025, 2)
